summary: Frontend-only testing of story filters + welcome profile card + sync/QR + profile editing + regression. All feature acceptance criteria met. No functional issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: WelcomePage.jsx uses window.location.href for the QR value; that will bake in any query string/hash. It works for the current use case but consider using the computed apiUrl or explicit welcome URL for portability.
SuccessStories filter falls back to Math.max(filtered.length,1) to avoid div-by-zero — good defensive code.
seed_data_creation: None. Left profile location='Madrid, ES', stack='Rust, Go' after editing test (per instructions this is acceptable).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iterations 1-7 all pass. Profile now stores Madrid, ES / Rust, Go — future tests should either accept these values or restore Barcelona, ES / Rust. Language auto-switches to ES on welcome page because backend member has language='es'. Header lang toggle exists but selector is not a native <button> role — use CSS/JS click to force switch if EN chip verification is required.
